rationale: Boston QF (Match 97) pits the 1I/Match77 and 1E/Match74 sides: Group I winners France/Norway vs Group E winners Germany and Group H/Spain side (1H heads Match 84, R32 in LA); Spain is the strongest team on this side (co-favorite ~+500, 1H), USA rides strong home form (4-1 Paraguay, 2-0 Australia, +2800) and faces a beatable 3rd-placed opponent then a winnable R16 in Philadelphia, so USA-Spain in Boston (24% per models) is the modal QF; France, Portugal and Argentina nominally feed the other half but bracket ambiguity warrants some weight.

Kansas City QF (Match 100) runs through 1K/1D vs 1B/1L routes with Group H (Spain) on that path via Match 88/96; Spain is the tournament co-favorite (~+500, resilient after 4-0 win over Saudi Arabia) and the most likely class of team on this side, with France/Portugal/Argentina/England as plausible alternatives given early bracket uncertainty.

July 14 semifinal (Match 101, Dallas) draws from the Boston/LA quarterfinal side where Spain and the France/Germany/Portugal block sit; Spain is the top rating team (highest Opta net team rating, horses for co-favorite ~+500) and the modal semifinalist from that half.

Atlanta semifinal (Match 102) comes from the Kansas City vs Miami quarterfinal side, where France/Argentina/England/Brazil funnel (simulations show England-Argentina and France as likely semifinalists from this half); France is the current outright favorite (+375 to +400) with Mbappe in rampant form, Argentina defending champions with Messi on 5 goals.

Third-place playoff is contested by semifinal losers and historically won by the slightly stronger team (e.g., Croatia 2022, Belgium 2018); top contenders by outright odds (France +375, Spain/England +550, Argentina +650, Brazil +900) are the most likely semifinal losers.

Messi leads the Golden Boot with 5 goals (hat-trick vs Algeria, brace vs Austria), Mbappe and Haaland have 4 each; with Argentina and France more likely to go deep than Norway into a knockout-heavy 104-match tournament, Messi and Mbappe are the clear two favorites, Haaland a live outsider.

Betting odds on June 22 have France +375 to +400 favorite, Spain and England +550, Argentina +650, Brazil +900; France won its opener 3-1 and then 3-0 over Iraq, Spain bounced back 4-0 over Saudi Arabia after a shock Cape Verde draw, Argentina's Messi is on record pace as defending champions.

Golden Ball bookmakers price Mbappe around 6.00 and Messi/olise around 7.00, and all previous winners reached the semifinals; Mbappe has 4 goals for favorite France, Messi leads scoring with 5 and record-breaking narrative as last World Cup (38-39), Olise (53 goal contributions for Bayern), Kane and Yamal (returned from hamstring, scored) are the leading alternatives.

Marciniak refereed the 2022 final and is Collina's favorite, though FIFA may avoid back-to-back finals; Letexier is the rising elite candidate but France reaching the final would rule him out, Turpin/Vincic are safe Champions League final officials, and Mexican Cesar Ramos is a plausible home-confederation pick if France is in the final.
